title: Geo-aware privacy pricing matrix and SCCs readiness checklist
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Define and validate a geo-aware pricing and contract packaging approach for enterprise customers that need EU/UK data residency, SCCs, subprocessors disclosures, and retention controls. Deliverables include: a pricing matrix with recommended uplift tiers, a set of legal-approved clause templates (DPA + SCC/UK Addendum), an internal sales one-pager, and an experiment plan to validate willingness-to-pay and conversion impact.
acceptance_criteria: Pricing matrix with 3 recommended add-on tiers (Residency Lite, Residency Plus, Dedicated Private) documented and ratified by Sales and Legal
DPA template with SCC annex and separate UK Addendum drafted and accepted by Legal Counsel
Subprocessor disclosure checklist published and publicly linkable from the contract UI
Retention control feature mapping (90/365/never) and UI/ops requirements agreed with Engineering
Experiment plan created with sample segments, pricing deltas, success metrics (win rate, ACV uplift, buy rate), and analytics dashboard paths
Customer-facing sales one-pager and self-serve add-on flow mockups available for Design review
Cross-functional kickoff held and action owners assigned for implementation work
tasks: Run stakeholder workshop with Legal, Sales, Account Management, Engineering, and Solutions (target 2026-02-17)
Draft initial pricing matrix and uplift recommendations (PM)
Legal: draft DPA + SCC annex + UK Addendum templates and internal approval loop
Engineering: assess retention enforcement feasibility and telemetry needs
Security: verify KMS/HSM gating for Private/Dedicated tiers
Design: create checkout flow mockups for add-ons and contract acceptance
Growth/Analytics: define experiment cohorts and event tracking (checkout metrics, conversion funnel)
Sales: prepare 5 pilot accounts and negotiation playbook for pilots
Publish subprocessor list and retention options on docs site and link in contract UI
decisions: Adopt EU SCCs as the primary lawful transfer mechanism for the EU residency add-on; include UK Addendum for UK customers
Offer three commercial tiers: Residency Lite (+20% price uplift), Residency Plus (+35% uplift + configurable retention), Dedicated Private (+80% uplift with VPC/KMS options)

Retention options to be surfaced as configuration choices during onboarding and enforced via policy in Dedicated/Private; Hosted customers will get 90-day default with a paid option for extended retention
Subprocessor transparency will be public and included in the DPA; major subprocessors flagged for high-risk review
Require Legal sign-off before any customer-facing docs go live; Sales enablement materials to be gated until templates are finalized
